articles.title: Why India’s industrial sector is looking beyond the grid for energy security
articles.summary: India's industrial energy transition is not about abandoning the grid — it is about building greater control around it. articles.summary: India has largely settled the question of whether solar can compete with grid electricity on price. Recent movement on curtailment, storage mandates and time-differentiated tariffs suggests the power market is reorganising around timing rather than cost.
